caption:
Major changes are coming to Dhaka's traffic! Karwan Bazar kitchen market and Fulbaria Bus Terminal are both being relocated.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has directed authorities to relocate the Karwan Bazar kitchen market to Gabtoli to reduce traffic congestion in Dhaka.

The decision was made during a meeting at the PMO to review the city's traffic situation, public transport management, and parking facilities.

To further modernize transport, an Electronic Toll Collection (ETC) system and a supporting app will be introduced at expressways and flyovers within four months.

The Fulbaria Bus Terminal will also be moved to Keraniganj, with a temporary terminal to be built on 15 acres of land under the Jhilmil project within four months.

The Prime Minister also ordered the expansion of the Gabtoli Bus Terminal's rear section to increase capacity and improve vehicle management.

Additionally, BUET has been asked to review congestion around the Jatrabari-Gulistan Flyover and provide recommendations within 15 days.

The government will formulate a separate policy to regulate auto-rickshaws and take action against unauthorized double-decker sleeper buses.

The Prime Minister emphasized strong coordination among agencies to ensure all tasks are completed within the stipulated deadlines.

headline_marked: PM directs [[action against unauthorised sleeper buses]] to ease Dhaka traffic
headline: PM directs action against unauthorised sleeper buses to ease Dhaka traffic
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has ordered a crackdown on illegal double-decker sleeper buses and announced several major infrastructure changes to reduce congestion in the capital.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has directed authorities to take action against unauthorised double-decker sleeper buses as part of a broader plan to restore order and modernise the transport sector in Dhaka.
During a meeting at the Tejgaon office on Saturday, the PM discussed traffic congestion, pressure on flyovers, public transport management, and the modernisation of traffic systems.
A key decision was made to implement the Electronic Toll Collection (ETC) system at toll plazas on expressways and flyovers, with a dedicated app to be developed within four months.
To address long-term congestion near the Jatrabari-Gulistan flyover, the PM ordered BUET to review existing reports and submit new recommendations within 15 days.

The Fulbaria bus terminal will be relocated to Keraniganj to reduce the pressure of inter-district buses in the central part of the city, with land acquisition starting via the Ministry of Local Government.
An interim temporary bus terminal will be constructed on 15 acres of land in the Jhilmil project within the next four months while the permanent relocation is underway.
The Gabtoli bus terminal's rear section will be expanded to increase capacity and improve vehicle management, coordinated by the Roads and Highways Department and traffic police.
Other measures include moving the Karwan Bazar kitchen market to Gabtoli and exploring parking options at the Osmani Memorial Auditorium to reduce congestion around the Secretariat.
Additionally, a new separate policy will be formulated to regulate and organize the movement of auto-rickshaws within Dhaka city.
caption:
No more illegal sleeper buses? Dhaka is getting a major transport overhaul to fight congestion.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has directed authorities to take action against unauthorised double-decker sleeper buses as part of a broader plan to restore order and modernise the transport sector in Dhaka.

During a meeting at the Tejgaon office on Saturday, the PM discussed traffic congestion, pressure on flyovers, public transport management, and the modernisation of traffic systems.

A key decision was made to implement the Electronic Toll Collection (ETC) system at toll plazas on expressways and flyovers, with a dedicated app to be developed within four months.

To address long-term congestion near the Jatrabari-Gulistan flyover, the PM ordered BUET to review existing reports and submit new recommendations within 15 days.

The Fulbaria bus terminal will be relocated to Keraniganj to reduce the pressure of inter-district buses in the central part of the city, with land acquisition starting via the Ministry of Local Government.

An interim temporary bus terminal will be constructed on 15 acres of land in the Jhilmil project within the next four months while the permanent relocation is underway.

The Gabtoli bus terminal's rear section will be expanded to increase capacity and improve vehicle management, coordinated by the Roads and Highways Department and traffic police.

Other measures include moving the Karwan Bazar kitchen market to Gabtoli and exploring parking options at the Osmani Memorial Auditorium to reduce congestion around the Secretariat.

Additionally, a new separate policy will be formulated to regulate and organize the movement of auto-rickshaws within Dhaka city.
